commander: Generalleutnant Wilhelm Falley (killed 6 June); Generalmajor Bernhard Klosterkemper temporary
composing_text: 1057th Grenadier Regiment; 1058th Grenadier Regiment; 191st Artillery Regiment
current_activity: fighting airborne landings in the Cotentin
notes: Division in the Cotentin (airborne drop zones); commander Generalleutnant Falley killed 6 June (ambush); Klosterkemper commanded 6-10 June, König from 10 June. Exact location of units on 6 June not geocoded. [Review item 1: the 6th Fallschirmjaeger Regiment (GER-FJR-006) is recorded as attached to this division in CR0372 from 6 June (Cross-Channel Attack ch. VII p. 237-238, 259-260; ch. VIII p. 292-293, n. 47); the CMH footnote says the subordination ordered by Seventh Army was apparently not effected on 6 June.]
1058th Grenadier Regiment counter-attacked from the north on Sainte-Mère-Église (defended by 505th PIR) on 7 June.

current_activity: beside the 243rd in the Lessay coastal sector, controlling remnants of the 77th Division and the 265th Kampfgruppe
notes: Event date: Breakout and Pursuit ch. 12 p. 227 gives the German order of battle on the morning of 24 July 1944, the day before the Cobra bombardment: the 91st stood beside the 243d near Lessay, with control over remaining elements of the 77th Division and the exhausted kampfgruppe of the 265th Division. Location: near Lessay, the coastal sector. Location approximate: the Green Book gives the sector, not the command post of the unit.
